title: how the site's notebook and graph pages stay fresh after a push
summary: The /notebook/ and /graph/ site pages are baked HTML snapshots that CI now regenerates fresh on every relevant push (via `coldstart index` plus the two build-site-page.mjs scripts, run before the Astro build), which only works because this repo's own notebook — previously fully gitignored as private working memory — was committed to git via `kb commit` so a fresh CI checkout has notes to fold at all.

steps.role: narrowed from a blanket `.coldstart/` to `.coldstart/*` plus `!.coldstart/notebook`, the change that makes committing the notebook possible at all
the sanctioned publish path; stages+commits only `.raw/` + okf.yaml + its own .gitignore, never the derived notes/*.md
folds the checked-out `.raw/` logs (buildViewData/loadAll) and bakes site-astro/src/notebook-page.html; needs dist/ built first
builds site-astro/src/graph-page.html from a freshly-built coldstart index plus git co-change history; always passes [] for notebook anchors

CI order: npm run build, then `coldstart index --root .`, then both generator scripts, then the site-astro build/deploy; push-trigger paths widened to src/**, .coldstart/notebook/**, and both generator script dirs so a notebook- or source-only push still redeploys

invariants: the graph page always passes [] for notebook anchors — no note content ever appears in /graph/, independent of whether the notebook itself is committed
CI builds its OWN fresh index via `coldstart index --root .`; the developer's local .coldstart/cache stays gitignored and is never read by CI
kb commit only publishes .raw/ + okf.yaml + .gitignore — never derived notes/*.md — so the site build must fold notes itself rather than read pre-rendered markdown
